a.lede: Amazon has suffered a major setback in its plans to offer a viable Starlink rival, after 40 satellites destined for low earth orbit were destroyed in a failed rocket launch.
a.title: Amazon’s Starlink rival sees major setback after 40 satellites destroyed in rocket failure

b.lede: United Launch Alliance (ULA) suffered what is reportedly its first mission failure in its 20-year history, failing to deliver 40 Amazon Leo satellites to orbit. Leo is Amazon's competitor to SpaceX's Starlink, but it has struggled to get off the ground so far, putting only a small portion of the necessary satellites to challenge Starlink […]
b.title: Vulcan rocket fails, destroying 40 Amazon Leo satellites
